latest_release.body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v1.2.0 -->

## What's Changed
### 🚀 Features
* Fear add windows digital ceritficate by @ja7ad in https://github.com/ja7ad/hydra/pull/307
* Feat support manual path for ffmpeg by @m4siha in https://github.com/ja7ad/hydra/pull/310
* Improve gui persist preferences and table controls by @sensifai-team in https://github.com/ja7ad/hydra/pull/313
* Feat embed product version in Windows binaries by @ja7ad in https://github.com/ja7ad/hydra/pull/318
* Feat customizable toolbar with Plugins button by @ja7ad in https://github.com/ja7ad/hydra/pull/324
* Feat open the file on double-click of a finished download by @ja7ad in https://github.com/ja7ad/hydra/pull/327
* Improve one GUI engine worker, coalesce ready reads, skip doomed digest by @ja7ad in https://github.com/ja7ad/hydra/pull/330
* Feat add keyboard range selection to batch download by @m4siha in https://github.com/ja7ad/hydra/pull/335
* Feat prefill notes with the source page of a captured download by @sensifai-team in https://github.com/ja7ad/hydra/pull/343
* Feat cli add --batch-file to hydra interactive by @ja7ad in https://github.com/ja7ad/hydra/pull/344
* Feat add browser plugin action by @ja7ad in https://github.com/ja7ad/hydra/pull/345
* Feat pick Save As folder from recent folders dropdown by @ja7ad in https://github.com/ja7ad/hydra/pull/350
* Feat gui add Downloaded column and Status progress bar by @ja7ad in https://github.com/ja7ad/hydra/pull/365
### 🐛 Bug Fixes
* Fix honor start-in-tray on macOS login by @ja7ad in https://github.com/ja7ad/hydra/pull/309
* Fix preserve drive roots in browser capture paths by @ja7ad in https://github.com/ja7ad/hydra/pull/312
* Fix keep scheduler queue rows visible by @ja7ad in https://github.com/ja7ad/hydra/pull/315
* Fix show File Info dialog for captured streams by @ja7ad in https://github.com/ja7ad/hydra/pull/316
* Fix run audio extraction with the resolved ffmpeg path by @ja7ad in https://github.com/ja7ad/hydra/pull/321
* Fix avoid macOS abort when closing a window with active text input by @ja7ad in https://github.com/ja7ad/hydra/pull/322
* Fix keep plugin download name when File Info probes the page by @ja7ad in https://github.com/ja7ad/hydra/pull/323
* Fix keep the captured name when a probe only re-escapes it in gui by @EmirMontazeri in https://github.com/ja7ad/hydra/pull/326
* Fix skip official plugin sync in builds without plugins by @ja7ad in https://github.com/ja7ad/hydra/pull/334
* Fix set name_from_browser only when the browser's name is usable by @EmirMontazeri in https://github.com/ja7ad/hydra/pull/333
* Fix appimage bundle libxkbcommon with libxkbcommon-x11 on mixed hosts by @ja7ad in https://github.com/ja7ad/hydra/pull/339
* Fix youtube plugin explain missing JS runtime on n-challenge failure by @ja7ad in https://github.com/ja7ad/hydra/pull/342
* Fix gui redraw at the new size after a Wayland resize by @ja7ad in https://github.com/ja7ad/hydra/pull/347
* Fix let yt-dlp find Node on Windows and enable it by default by @ja7ad in https://github.com/ja7ad/hydra/pull/353
* Fix gui replay the browser User-Agent on captured downloads by @m4siha in https://github.com/ja7ad/hydra/pull/354
* Fix cli keep the TUI queue list within the screen and scroll  by @sensifai-team in https://github.com/ja7ad/hydra/pull/359
* Fix cli scroll the interactive queue list with the selection by @ja7ad in https://github.com/ja7ad/hydra/pull/360
* Fix updater keep macOS Full Disk Access across updates by @ja7ad in https://github.com/ja7ad/hydra/pull/362
* Fix updater honour Connection proxy and update portable builds by @ja7ad in https://github.com/ja7ad/hydra/pull/366
* Fix send Chrome's header set to servers that gate on it by @ja7ad in https://github.com/ja7ad/hydra/pull/368
### Other Changes
* Feat detect Portable.ini beside the exe for portable mode gui by @ja7ad in https://github.com/ja7ad/hydra/pull/373

## New Contributors
* @EmirMontazeri made their first contribution
